title: Dashboard
descriptionWithTime: Generated at {{time}}. Online count tracks lease heartbeats; accounts are reclaimed if Redis heartbeats drop.
descriptionDefault: Online accounts, anomalies, worker heartbeats, and task queue backlog.

telegramNotReady.message: Telegram API credentials are not configured; Worker is idle and will not connect to Telegram or run tasks
telegramNotReady.introBeforeCode: This is a Telegram requirement, not a system limit: every third-party client (including this console) must use its own
telegramNotReady.introAfterCode: credentials to connect. Registration is free and takes a few minutes:
telegramNotReady.step1AfterLink: and sign in with your phone number (enter the verification code).
telegramNotReady.step2AfterBold: , enter any App title / Short name, and create the app.
telegramNotReady.tip: Tip: One pair of credentials can serve multiple accounts. For large fleets, split across several pairs to reduce rate-limit impact. Never use public api_id values found online.

noAccounts.description: Accounts are the starting point of the system: sign in with one account via verification code so the console can sync dialogs, receive messages, and send on command. Run a quick check on the Accounts page afterward to verify it is online.

stats.abnormalHint: Needs code / Frozen / Invalid / Dead / Disabled

trends.title: Online Trends
trends.subtitle: Online accounts / abnormal accounts / succeeded / failed tasks aggregated hourly (daily for 7d and 30d)
trends.chartEmpty: No trend samples yet; data points will appear automatically once collected.

workers.title: Worker Heartbeats
workers.subtitle: Highlighted in red if no heartbeat for >60s — check here first when on call
workers.emptyDesc: Heartbeat records will appear here once a worker starts.
workers.staleAlertDesc: Action: check the host to verify the worker process is running (inspect process list and logs) and restart if needed. Leases will be reclaimed automatically after expiry without losing account data.

failures.title: Recent Failed Tasks
failures.subtitle: Latest 10 failures ordered by creation time

queue.title: Task Queue Backlog
queue.subtitle: Click a counter to inspect details in Task Center
queue.explanation: Overdue: past scheduled time and not yet claimed by a worker. Stuck: running past timeout and requires manual intervention.

notifications.title: Unread Notifications
notifications.defaultSubtitle: Task failures / Worker offline / Account anomalies / Backup failures
